row.title: A window in seconds against a millisecond column read the whole ultrastable-ops hits table on every call
row.body: READ-BUDGET-12: growthHits bound a seconds window to hits.at (milliseconds), so the three aggregate queries matched every row: all-time counts and about 24,000 rows read per query, every 90 seconds, 3.4M rows an hour against a 50,000 budget; the D1 query analytics named the queries. Fixed: a millisecond window and a 10-minute Cache API entry; tests pass (site/growth-hits.test.mjs), verified by the second call making no database read.
